text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, just look at the state of me… How could this happen?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, I did eat a burger, fries, and some snacks. Yeah, I may have overdone it a bit…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But even so, my skin looks terrible. You've gotta be kidding me… Does food really have this much of an effect?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Man, this sucks. I need to take some vitamins or something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan is feeling down after seeing the state of her skin…
